title: Quota
readonly_notice: Quota writes are disabled on the server (LLMIO_QUOTA_ALLOW_WRITE=false). Data is still queried and shown normally, but adding, editing and deleting sources are all turned off.
edit_disabled: Read-only mode — edit entry points are hidden

chartStyle.progress_desc: One row per item, most information
chartStyle.ring_desc: A meter for the tightest item
chartStyle.bar_desc: Compare several items side by side

card.no_items: This source has no enabled quota items
card.no_percent: These items have no total, so no percentage can be computed

empty.title: No data sources configured
empty.desc: Add a source, or import one from an upstream llmio provider. Three types are supported: built-in adapters (verified official endpoints), HTTP endpoints (your own URL and field map), and scripts (a piece of JS run in a sandbox).

editor.name: Source name
editor.type_builtin_hint: Calls a verified official quota endpoint. Most only need a base URL and an API key.
editor.type_http_hint: Specify the URL, auth and field map yourself — works with any endpoint that returns JSON.
editor.type_script_hint: Runs a piece of JavaScript in a sandbox and hands the quota to output(). For endpoints that need multi-step login or computation.
editor.id_hint: Used as the key for per-source display overrides
editor.path_hint: Leave empty to use the adapter's built-in path. Required for the custom endpoint adapter.
editor.api_key_placeholder: Leave empty to keep the saved key
editor.advanced: Request overrides & field map (only when the adapter's expectations don't match)
editor.query_hint: Appended to the url; join multiple params with &. Same notation as the built-in adapters.
editor.headers_hint: One per line as name=value. Values accept the same placeholders as the url (apiKey / baseUrl / id / name); the auth section above adds one more header.
editor.items_path_placeholder: e.g. data.items — once set, the response is parsed via the map below
editor.map_placeholder:
One per line: "target=response.path", e.g.
label=name
used=usage.used
total=usage.limit
unit==CREDITS
editor.map_hint: Available targets: id / label / used / total / remaining / unit / window / resetAt / expireAt / status / format. A value starting with = is a literal.
editor.constants_placeholder:
One per line: "field=value", e.g.
window=month
unit=CNY
editor.script_hint: Hand a piece of JSON to output() (or just return it). console.log is kept as debug output. Read secrets from the environment variables below rather than hardcoding them.
editor.env_placeholder:
One per line: KEY=VALUE, e.g.
SCNET_USER=your_user
SCNET_PASS=your_pass
editor.env_hint: Scripts read secrets from the environment — safer than embedding them (values are masked on the way out).
editor.env_hint_builtin: Login-based adapters take their account and session here too (see the placeholder for the key names); values are masked on the way out.
editor.allow_fetch: Allow the script to make network requests
editor.allow_fetch_hint: Off by default. When on, the script may fetch public addresses (private ranges are blocked).
editor.note_placeholder: Optional, shown at the card's footer

test.raw_value: Raw value returned by the adapter
test.hint: A test run neither saves nor caches. After editing the script or map, one click tells you whether it works.

item.title: Customize this item
item.format_hint: Empty uses the default format. Unknown placeholders are shown verbatim so typos are visible.
item.chart_style_hint: Applies to this item only: with the card set to Ring, items set to Ring are drawn as rings (with none set, the tightest one is), and the rest become progress bars.
item.hidden_hint: Hidden items are not rendered on this card (data is still fetched)

source_view.title: Source display settings
source_view.hint: This only changes display, not fetching. To change the endpoint or key, use the gear on the card.

settings.title: Quota global settings
settings.refresh_interval_hint: The server reuses the last result within this window, avoiding frequent upstream calls. Minimum 10s.
settings.warning_at_hint: Usage at or above this ratio is marked as a warning.

import.title: Import from llmio
import.desc: These are the providers already configured in the gateway. After import the key is read by the server directly and never passes through the browser.
import.empty: No providers configured in the gateway yet
import.name: Provider
import.note_hint: Login-based adapters are imported disabled; fill in the credentials in the editor before enabling.

charts.no_chart: These items have no total, so they cannot be charted
charts.label: Item
